learned: 2026-10-09, by an agent: ocbusa.com is Shopify with a public /products.json (251 products, vendor 'OCB®'). Each product is listed up to three times: the parent with a 'Single Booklet' (or 'Single Pack') and an 'N Count Display' variant, and copies titled ', Booklet' / ', Single' and ', Display'. Leaves and cones per pack are in the product pages' PAPER SPECS / CONE SPECS bullets (server-rendered, not in products.json); read 2026-10-09 for all 51 consumer products, they are regular by width (merch_counts).
notes: Kept: the parent product's single-pack variant. Out: display boxes (a distributor's unit), the ', Booklet' / ', Single' / ', Display' copies of a parent, bundles, rollers, cone towers, Stack Paks (300-leaf packs), Roll Kits, grinders, trays, mats and the Houseplant by OCB co-brand (sold only by the display).

The title names line, width and format: 'Organic Hemp Slim Rolling Papers + Tips', 'Bamboo King Cones', 'Unbleached 1¼ Cones 32 Pack'. 'Slim' is the king size slim, 'King' cones are 109mm, 'Mini' cones 70mm. Read by the store-listing rules (merch_catalog.reading), so site and stores agree by construction.

Counts from the spec bullets: papers 1¼ and single wide 50 leaves, slim 32 (with 32 or 50 tips on '+ Tips'); cones mini 10, 1¼ 6, king 3; Unbleached also sells a 1¼ 32-pack and a king 24-pack, whose titles state the count.

Bamboo 1¼ cones also come in an 8-pack ('Small Size', 78mm on some menus) that ocbusa.com no longer lists; Leafly lists it (leafly.com/brands/ocb/products/ocb-1-1-4-bamboo-cones-8-pack-rolling-papers) and stores still sell it (Kaya Bliss, 2026-10-09). Owner-confirmed.
